lastCompletedStory.title: Wire plan-runner planner and auditor dispatches through verified out-of-band dispatch with observable terminals

nextStoryContext: Plan-runner planner and auditor spawns now always use runVerifiedDispatch with pane_pid before/after checks, checked set-option/respawn-pane/pipe-pane calls, prompt-file transport and terminal cleanup. Planner/auditor timeout sentinels also use the checked helper, then emit a timeout event, durable dispatch-failed marker and notification. Production wiring persists/removes .cam-dispatch-failed.json and notifies the orchestrator; all pre-existing plan-runner test fakes that reach dispatch now synthesize a real pane_pid transition through test/helpers/verified-pane-pid-spawn.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Official tmux master manpage confirms respawn-pane -k kills the existing command, pane_pid is the PID of the first process in the pane, set-option -p targets pane options, and pipe-pane connects target-pane output to a shell command.
